blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteRbacPoliciesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes RBAC policies. When an actor is provided, it validates
that the actor holds every policy being deleted.

steps.name: validateActorPermissionsStep
steps.description:
Validates that an actor has access to all the policies they are trying to assign.
An actor can only create roles and add policies that they themselves have access to.

steps.name: deleteRbacPoliciesStep
steps.description:
This step deletes one or more RBAC policies. The built-in super admin policy
can't be deleted, and neither can a policy that a role still holds.

children.name: actor_id
children.description:
The actor deleting the policies. When provided, the actor must hold every
policy being deleted, mirroring the check applied when attaching them.
Omit for trusted system code.
